materialBoundaries.counterexample: Relying on t.TempDir mode can yield a 0755 child under a common umask, while broadening the parser to accept 0755 would weaken custody.
materialBoundaries.invariant: Bound-credential parsing must require an exact private directory and regular single-link file without relaxing production custody.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The fixture chmods and verifies 0700/0600 before Open; dedicated negatives change the directory to 0755 and the file to 0644 and require nil bundle plus ErrSnapshotUnavailable. Product parser code is not relaxed.

materialBoundaries.counterexample: Nil Listen or zero ShutdownTimeout returns at RunWith lines 117-120, so a green-looking test could never observe claim or cleanup.
materialBoundaries.invariant: The MODEL must reach source-bound credential claim, fail before listener publication, close the claimed manager, and keep the process arm one-use.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The patched fixture supplies a positive timeout and a sentinel listener, requires the fixed initialize-TLS error, requires the listener to remain uncalled, verifies ErrSnapshotClosed from the retained manager, and rejects rearm.

materialBoundaries.counterexample: Accepting either legacy or current hash independently per file would allow an unreviewed mixed support-wrapper closure.
materialBoundaries.invariant: Native first-Completion evidence may accept only the exact current five-file OLD_V5 closure, never a legacy/current per-file union.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: old_v5_compatibility fixes the active revision, exact key set and count, exact two-path delta, valid digest syntax, and exact equality with the current tuple; the MODEL rejects both mixed tuples, all five single-file drifts, legacy revision, and unknown revision.

materialBoundaries.counterexample: Manually approximating gofmt output could alter literals or omit one target while satisfying a superficial empty-format claim.
materialBoundaries.invariant: The official Linux gofmt changes must be transferred without semantic edits to production code.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The original 3213-byte patch with SHA-256 abce17f9c390903dd8b071db0e7b7af572db4fc75a704135f87207cb83d44ce5 applies strictly to the base and reverse-applies strictly to the candidate, covering exactly three targets.

recoverability.rationale: There are no migrations or persistent-state transformations. The patch is a six-file test/evidence-gate change plus formatter-only production afterimages and can be reverted as one commit before any evidence is accepted.

regressionLikelihood.rationale: The semantic Go edits are confined to test fixtures, preserve strict filesystem custody, and drive RunWith through its documented option gate to a pre-listener TLS error. The OLD_V5 update requires one exact five-file active tuple and rejects legacy, mixtures, and drift. Remaining likelihood is dominated by the unexecuted Linux Go compilation and tagged tests.

regressionProtection.rationale: The exact six-file manifest, strict patch round trips, official formatter-patch transfer, active OLD_V5 digest tuple, and 300 Python checks passed independently. No Go compiler, Linux exact-tag test, or post-integration gofmt check ran in this review.
